title: CommunityTemplateManifest
description: Canonical manifest for a community-submitted Graphock template. This schema describes contributor-authored template metadata only; trusted source metadata such as repository, path, PR URL, commit SHA, merge time, and GitHub author must be supplied by the submission workflow, not by template.yaml.

code.description: Stable public template code, unique across the community template catalog.

description.description: Short public description shown in catalog cards and detail pages.

categories.description: Lowercase category slugs used for browsing and filtering.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. The public repository validator applies the owner-approved allowlist.

inline.description: Inline prompt text. Validators must not print this value in full.

prompt.description: Prompt body, either inline or referenced by a template-relative file path.

config.description: Template runtime configuration. Consumers must validate any provider-specific fields before execution.

mapping_config.description: Optional graph import mapping used when the template creates a local graph database.
